user_request: Neutral shared layer, packet C3: inject the record mapper into RpcSession so the transport-neutral driver depends on no Pi module, update the call sites, tidy stale docs, and test the injection.
instructions:
NEVER run git stash, git checkout, git reset, git restore, git clean, git merge, git rebase, git push, git commit, git mv or any command that changes the index, the stash stack, or other worktrees' state. Do NOT touch crates/ajax-web/web/. Do NOT write to /tmp. No `timeout` binary on this host: use the perl alarm form. Do NOT explore: read ONLY rpc_session.rs, the call-site lines named, the first 45 lines of rpc_session_tests.rs, and mod.rs. FIRST action: edit rpc_session.rs. When you edit mod.rs every `mod *_tests;` line must stay directly preceded by its own #[cfg(test)]; re-read after editing. Do NOT commit.

FACTS (verified; do not explore). All files are in crates/ajax-web/src/adapters/web_session_acp/.

GOAL: the transport-neutral session driver must not import anything from a Pi module. Today rpc_session.rs has `use super::pi_rpc_map::map_record;` (line ~30) and calls `map_record(value, self.session_id())` inside the record-folding method (line ~252: `let mapping: RpcMapping = map_record(value, self.session_id());`). Make the mapper an injected, required constructor argument.

CALL SITES of `RpcSession::new(process, handshake)` that must change (add the mapper as the third argument): rpc_session_tests.rs lines 73, 106, 135, 154, 166, 184, 208 (all `RpcSession::new(process, handshake)`); rpc_session_request_tests.rs line 44 (`RpcSession::new(process, handshake)`) and line 172 (`RpcSession::new(process, handshake_result)`); pi_rpc_client.rs line 133 (`RpcSession::new(process, hs)`). In each of those three files add `use super::pi_rpc_map::map_record;` (merge it into the existing `use super::...` block) and pass `map_record` as the new last argument. NO other edit in those two test files (no assertion, helper or string changes).

THE TYPE: in rpc_session.rs add `pub type RecordMapper = fn(&Value, &str) -> RpcMapping;` (next to RpcMapping). The struct RpcSession (fields: process, session_id, queued, prompt_id, run_active, ended_aborted, exited) gets a new field `mapper: RecordMapper`. `pub fn new(process: JsonlProcess, handshake: RpcHandshake) -> Self` becomes `pub fn new(process: JsonlProcess, handshake: RpcHandshake, mapper: RecordMapper) -> Self` and stores it. The folding line becomes `let mapping: RpcMapping = (self.mapper)(value, self.session_id());`. Remove the `use super::pi_rpc_map::map_record;` import from rpc_session.rs. Both `pi_rpc_map::map_record` and `claude_sdk_map::map_sdk_message` already have exactly the signature `fn(&Value, &str) -> RpcMapping`.

DOC/COMMENT TIDY (comments only, no code): (a) rpc_session.rs module doc: first sentence becomes `//! The transport-neutral session driver core on top of [`JsonlProcess`].` and every mention of `[`pi_rpc_map`]` / `[`map_record`]` / `agent_settled` / "pi's error text" is reworded to refer to "the injected record mapper" (a `response` record whose id matches the active prompt decides that run; every other record is folded through the mapper). Also add the missing blank line before the `/// One step of a Pi RPC run as seen by the session driver.` doc of RpcStep and change that doc to `/// One step of a run as seen by the session driver.` (b) rpc_handshake.rs: DELETE the stale lines `// Not yet reachable from the crate surface: nothing wires this in until the connection-loop task lands, so every public item is dead code for now.` and `#![allow(dead_code)]` (the types are used); if clippy then reports dead code, restore ONLY the attribute and say so in CONCERNS. (c) jsonl_process.rs: reword only the first doc paragraph so it describes a generic child process speaking LF-delimited JSONL (no `pi --mode rpc` wording); keep the framing-rules paragraph as is.

NEW TEST FILE rpc_session_mapper_tests.rs, declared in mod.rs as its own `#[cfg(test)]` line directly followed by `mod rpc_session_mapper_tests;` inserted BETWEEN existing pairs (never between a `#[cfg(test)]` and its `mod`). Copy the helper that spawns the fake Pi child and runs the handshake from the first 45 lines of rpc_session_tests.rs. Tests: (1) a custom mapper `fn finish_on_agent_start(record: &Value, _id: &str) -> RpcMapping` that returns finished=true (no events, not aborted) when record["type"] == "agent_start" and an empty mapping otherwise: begin_prompt on the fake, then next_step yields RpcStep::RunFinished { aborted: false } at agent_start (proving the injected mapper, not Pi's, decides) and run_active() is false afterwards; (2) a mapper that returns an empty mapping for everything: after begin_prompt the session never reports RunFinished within a 1s next_step window (Idle) while run_active() stays true; (3) a compile-time check `let _: RecordMapper = crate::adapters::web_session_acp::claude_sdk_map::map_sdk_message;` written as a function-pointer coercion inside a #[test] (adjust the path to whatever the sibling module path is in this directory: `super::claude_sdk_map::map_sdk_message`) and the same for `super::pi_rpc_map::map_record`.
